name: Scholomance: Krastinov's Ghoulish Potion takes control of the ghoul
contract: Doctor Theolen Krastinov (11261) throws Krastinov's Ghoulish Potion (92624) at a damage dealer, and its 3-yard splash catches everyone next to them: a ghoul transform plus a charm for 10 s (tooltip: 'Ghoulified. Charmed for 10 seconds.'). The charm effect carries the base value 1, which the core reads as the highest level it may charm, so the ghoul kept full control (#13937). On Ascension the potion often caught two or three players at once; they took no action for the 10 s and Krastinov kept fighting (combat logs of 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-16). A real charm here would turn the ghouls against their group and, when the splash catches everyone, leave Krastinov without enemies so he resets. The control effect is therefore a stun. Expected: the damage dealer and the tank beside them are stunned, nobody changes sides, Krastinov stays in combat, and control returns when the potion ends. The setup follows the potion targeting scenario: tank, healer and damage dealer by specialization, grouped in Stormwind and teleported into one Scholomance instance.
